label: Beam, section size free
derivation: Stiffness: δ ∝ F L³ / (E I) with I ∝ A² → A ∝ E^−½ → m = ρ A L ∝ ρ / E^½
geometry: Length L fixed; cross-section shape fixed, its size (area A) free. I ∝ A², Z ∝ A^1.5.

label: Beam, section size free
derivation: Strength: M = σf Z with Z ∝ A^1.5 → A ∝ σf^−⅔ → m ∝ ρ / σf^⅔
geometry: Length L fixed; cross-section shape fixed, its size (area A) free. I ∝ A², Z ∝ A^1.5.

label: Beam, fixed width, depth free
derivation: Stiffness: δ ∝ 1/(E h³) → h ∝ E^−⅓ → m ∝ ρ / E^⅓
geometry: Length and width b fixed; depth h free. I = b h³/12, Z = b h²/6.

label: Beam, fixed width, depth free
derivation: Strength: M = σf b h²/6 → h ∝ σf^−½ → m ∝ ρ / σf^½
geometry: Length and width b fixed; depth h free. I = b h³/12, Z = b h²/6.

label: Column, section size free
derivation: Buckling: F = π² E I / L² with I ∝ A² → A ∝ E^−½ → m ∝ ρ / E^½
geometry: Height L fixed; section shape fixed, area A free. Axial load F.

label: Column, section size free
derivation: Crushing: A = F / σc → m ∝ ρ / σc
geometry: Height L fixed; section shape fixed, area A free. Axial load F.

label: Panel in bending, thickness free
derivation: Stiffness: δ ∝ 1/(E t³) → t ∝ E^−⅓ → m ∝ ρ / E^⅓
geometry: Span and width fixed; thickness t free (a plate in bending, same algebra as beam_depth with b = 1 m).

label: Panel in bending, thickness free
derivation: Strength: σf = 6M/t² → t ∝ σf^−½ → m ∝ ρ / σf^½
geometry: Span and width fixed; thickness t free (a plate in bending, same algebra as beam_depth with b = 1 m).

label: Wall, thickness free
derivation: Slenderness: t ≥ h/k (k = 27 partition, 18 load-bearing), a rule of thumb independent of the material → t fixed → m ∝ ρ
geometry: 1 m² of wall, height fixed; thickness t free.

label: Wall, thickness free
derivation: Crushing (load-bearing): t = N / σc for a line load N → m ∝ ρ / σc
geometry: 1 m² of wall, height fixed; thickness t free.

label: Wall, thickness free
derivation: Sound insulation (partition): single-leaf mass law: Rw ≥ 40 dB needs ≈ 100 kg/m² whatever the material → fixed mass
geometry: 1 m² of wall, height fixed; thickness t free.

label: Sound absorber, thickness free
derivation: Absorption: project assumption: thickness needed scales with 1/αw, anchored on PET felt 40 mm at αw 0.8 → m ∝ ρ / αw
geometry: 1 m² of panel; thickness t free.
warning: αw does not scale linearly with thickness, and there is no αw ≥ 0.7 pass mark: a poor absorber passes, only heavier.

label: Tensioned membrane, thickness free
derivation: Tension: T = σt t → t = T / σt → m ∝ ρ / σt
geometry: 1 m² of membrane; thickness t free. Design load T per metre width.

label: Fixed geometry (mass ∝ ρ)
derivation: Fixed volume: m = ρ V, so mass only scales with density
geometry: Geometry set by the product (a skirting profile, a 15 mm floor finish); nothing to size.
